title: Synthesis and characterization of spin coated ZnTe thin films for improving the efficiency of ZnTe/ZnS solar cell using SCAPS-1D
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7069-7077
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00417A, Paper
Open Access

Md. Hasan Ali, Md. Dulal Haque, Md. Faruk Hossain, Abu Zafor Md. Touhidul Islam
ZnTe thin films were synthesised and deposited on glass substrate for use as an absorber layer in TFSCs. The highest PCE is found 17.45% with Voc of 1.41 V, Jsc of 14.01 mA cm−2 and FF of 88.53% for the 1184 nm thickness and 1.77 eV band gap of ZnTe which was annealed at 400 °C.
